summary.most_likely_cause: kubelet repeatedly restarted after containerd socket response delays and conntrack saturation.

evidence.finding: containerd socket health check exceeded timeout.

root_cause_candidates.cause: containerd hang caused kubelet node status update failures.
conntrack saturation caused intermittent API Server connectivity from the node.

recommended_actions.action: Collect additional kubelet and containerd journal lines for the incident window.
Restart kubelet after operator approval if the node remains NotReady.
Review conntrack sizing through GitOps configuration.
